_comment: Limited-time events, content only - see the Events engine in Assets/Scripts/Core/Data (EventDef/Enums.EventActivityKind) and Assets/Scripts/Core/Session/GameSession.cs (RecordEventActivity/ClaimEventMilestone/RedeemEventCurrency). startUnix/endUnix are UTC Unix seconds, same style as balance.json's dailyResetHourUtc but an absolute window rather than an hour-of-day. 'activity' is one Enums.EventActivityKind member - today SummonPerformed or RelicDustSpent. 'pointsPerActivity' converts one unit of that activity into points on the milestone ladder every event has. Each milestone's 'id' is what a claim is saved against: permanent once shipped, never derived from its threshold or position, and never reused - retune a threshold freely, but a new rung takes a new id (see EventMilestone); 'currencyName' non-empty adds a second, optional ladder paid for in the event's own currency, earned from the same activity at 'currencyPerActivity'. Every number in this file - both windows, every threshold, every reward, both conversion rates - is a first-pass placeholder, not tuned content; nothing here has been through a balance pass.
